name: 26" Premium Full Aluminum Zipperless Checked Luggage - 3x TSA Locks (Faulty Wheels / As-Is)
description: Selling a 26-inch premium heavy-duty full aluminum hardshell checked luggage in matte black [Amazon](https://amazon.com). Features an ultra-secure zipperless design with reinforced corners and three integrated TSA-approved combination locks along the aluminum frame. The interior structure is perfectly intact, clean, and fully functional for storage. **Critical Fault/Flaw Transparency**: The bottom spinner wheels are faulty/damaged and do not roll smoothly under weight. The exterior aluminum shell also features heavy aesthetic wear, sticker residues, scratches, and packing tape marks from intense airline transit. This is sold strictly **AS-IS / FOR PARTS** or as a stationary storage trunk. It is an amazing project for anyone willing to install aftermarket replacement wheels or use it as a heavy-duty storage locker. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly apartment with a resident cat. The suitcase has been thoroughly vacuumed, cleaned, and sanitized, though minor pet dust particles might remain due to static. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging or dust bags; please prep your vehicle's trunk space for pickup.
contact_note: SOLD STRICTLY AS-IS. Faulty wheels—requires lifting or a vehicle with direct trunk loading. Pre-assembled structure. From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: 26-inch full aluminum hardshell checked luggage for sale. Matte black zipperless design with 3 TSA locks. Faulty wheels, sold AS-IS for parts or storage.
name_zh: 26寸全金属铝镁合金无拉链硬壳大容量托运箱 / 行李箱 (3个海关锁-轮子损坏现售)
description_zh: 超低价工业风清仓转让一个 26 英寸全金属铝镁合金硬壳航空托运箱（哑光黑色）[京东](https://www.jd.com/phb/173295e96d6e29ea44dbf.html)。采用极为硬核安全的无拉链铝框扣锁设计，四周带有加厚防撞金属包角，并配备了整整 **3 个原装集成式 TSA 海关密码锁**，安全防盗级别极高 [淘宝](https://www.taobao.com/chanpin/e8b9970a8f4e85f403478de252efc4c8c45b5f2572c7470c6224aa4b265508cf.html)。箱体内部框架完好、内衬干净，锁扣闭合完全正常。**【核心瑕疵硬核透明披露】**：底部的万向轮已损坏、负重下无法顺畅滚动；且经历过多次航空高强度托运，金属外壳带有大量不可避免的刮痕、托运贴纸残留、胶带封箱痕迹（如图所示）。现严格作为 **AS-IS（瑕疵品/拆件/无退换）** 现状低价处理，非常适合愿意自己买配件更换轮子的动手达人，或者直接留在车库/宿舍当做无敌坚固、带密码锁的高级储物箱（Trunk）使用。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前内部已完成高功率吸尘和表面全面酒精擦拭消毒。本商品不含任何原厂防尘袋或外包装，自提的买家朋友请直接开车来将其放入后备箱载走。
